cwe_content.cwe: CWE-22,Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

candidate.Reason: Uses safe_join() to prevent path traversal but needs verification of STATIC_PATH_LIB being properly restricted
Directly joins user-provided path with app.cwd without proper path traversal checks
Uses secure_filename() but still vulnerable to path traversal if secure_filename is not properly implemented or if app.cwd can be manipulated
